summary.text: Patrick M. Gallivan is a Republican state senator from New York who represents District 60 and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former New York State Police captain and Erie County sheriff, he has served in the State Senate since 2011.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Gallivan lives in Elma, New York.
He earned a B.S. in physical education from Canisius College and an M.A. in criminal justice from the State University of New York at Albany.

According to Ballotpedia, his career included service as a trooper, sergeant, lieutenant and captain of the New York State Police, as sheriff of Erie County, as a partner of GDY Professional Investigations, and as a member of the State Board of Parole.
Ballotpedia lists Gallivan's current committee assignments as Health (ranking member) and Transportation.
